title: Chick Webb's enlarged band on ten New England dates
summary: Webb enlarged to ten pieces for a New England tour with Hodges, Williams and the Savoy band, but the band rehearsed constantly and found little work.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So I think when Lou Henry's contract ran out... He was there three months. I think that's when... Well, that's when I went to Chick Webb. I think I went with Chick then. Because Chick wasn't doing anything, and he was getting ready to go to Boston. -- he had ten dates up in New England. So he was enlarging his band. He had eight pieces, and he was enlarging it to ten. Me and a trumpet, but who the other trumpet was, I don't know. I can't think right now.
Anyway, I worked for ten dates in New England with Chick's band.
This was now Bobby Stark again on trumpet?
Bobby was still with him. Bobby never left. And Johnny Hodges was there... He had the regular band he had at the Savoy.
Holmes (10/9) - 74
And you were there, Elmer Williams then...
I don't... Well, Elmer Williams, yeah...
And Johnny. So you and Johnny went on a tour, then.
Yeah, for ten days up in New England. And the band was enlarged. Now, I'm supposed to be a regular member of the band. Well, maybe...
Slats was still on trombone, or did he have R.H. Horton.
Oh, no. Slats waas still there.
Slats was still there.
Yeah. Same as the original band.
I see.
This (?) guy ...(?)... still on bass.
And Truehart.
Oh, True was with Chick's band!
And Kirkpatrick.

Kirkpatrick, yeah. So I was supposed to be a member of Chick's band, you know. Well, makin' rehearsals every day, we rehearsed... Because we always had good music to rehearse. And Chick would get a kick out of hearing the band rehearse. He liked to hear it rehearse so much he didn't get no work for it! So everybody was working in somebody else's band. I don't know what they had against Chick. Heh... He didn't get no work. But he had good
Holmes (10/9) - 75
bands. Always had good bands.
